gaps.sentence: ___ spite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
I wish I ___ told him the truth at the time.
gaps.explanation: 'wish + past perfect' for regret about the past.

gaps.sentence: The cat cleans ___ after every meal.
gaps.explanation: Reflexive: the cat cleans ITSELF (the object is the same as the subject).

gaps.sentence: The garden is ___ than I expected — it's huge!
By this time tomorrow, we ___ have finished the whole report.
gaps.explanation: 'By + future time' calls for the future perfect: will have finished.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather walk than ___ the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'would rather do A than do B' — both bare infinitives.

gaps.sentence: I'd sooner ___ at home than go to the party.
